title: FCA to take over AML supervision of law firms: final policy set
summary: The government has set its final policy on how the FCA will supervise anti-money laundering compliance in professional services firms, including law firms. Legislation is still needed and no start date has been given.
what_changes: The FCA will take over AML/CTF supervision of legal, accountancy, and trust and company service providers.
The final policy covers registration and gatekeeping, supervisory powers, guidance, information-sharing and enforcement.
It also covers funding, transition arrangements and how the FCA will be held accountable.
Legislative changes are still needed before the new supervisory model takes effect.
who_it_applies_to: Law firms doing work in scope of the Money Laundering Regulations.

history.event: Government published its consultation response setting out final policy positions.
